text: 連成・拘束・粒子法 低Mach数のPDE前処理 教育用例・関連コードあり 低Mach数での音響・対流尺度と、擬似時間の質量行列または数値散逸の前処理を区別します。専用の軽量例は、物理時間を保つMiczek系Roe散逸行列の実装と通常Roeを比較します。 別名・表記：low Mach preconditioning / 低マッハ数前処理 / 低Mach数前処理 / PDE preconditioning 解説と位置付け 解説章を読む この例の前提 Smooth fixed isentropic-vortex data for the unforced 2D ideal-gas Euler equations; gamma=1.4. Matrix preconditioning is applied to numerical dissipation, retaining the physical-time mass matrix. Only the stated fixed Mach numbers, grids, acoustic CFL and short time interval are validated. 境界条件: Periodic finite box. The whole-plane Gaussian analytic vortex has tiny nonzero minimum-image seam tails, which are explicitly qualified. 単位系: Nondimensional: far-field density1, background velocity(1,.5), beta3, box[-10,10]^2; pressure scales consistently with the chosen background Mach number. 小規模な専用実装と実測検証 背景Mach数.1/.01の滑らかな2D Euler等エントロピー渦で、両流束に無制限の中心primitive MUSCL再構築を用い、通常RoeとMiczek系の数値散逸行列前処理D=P⁻¹|PA|を比較します。SSPRK(3,3)で元の物理時間項と音響CFLを保ち、速度誤差・動圧規格化した圧力誤差・周期保存収支・標本Fourier診断を分けて評価します。擬似時間・二重時間積分の定常加速や、勾配制限・TVDの保証は扱いません。 低Mach等エントロピー渦：前処理Roe流束の軽量検証 · 条件・数式・一次文献 コード・固定入力・テスト・結果 ZIP · 35件の検査と独立展開記録 選択した固定例の検証です。共通22例の台帳とは別の補助配布版で、各手法の全変種を検証するものではありません。 適用範囲と残る作業 数値散逸側の限定実装です。定常反復の加速、二重時間積分、衝撃波、一般の非線形安定性・正値性、音響刻み制約の除去、全Mach域で一様な精度を保証しません。 文献への入口 Preconditioned methods for solving the incompressible and low speed compressible equations (1987) Time dependent calculations using multigrid, with applications to unsteady flows past airfoils and wings (1991) Approximate Riemann solvers, parameter vectors, and difference schemes (1981) On Godunov-Type Methods for Gas Dynamics (1988) On Godunov-type methods near low densities (1991) Very simple, carbuncle-free, boundary-layer-resolving, rotated-hybrid Riemann solvers (2008) New numerical solver for flows at various Mach numbers (2015) A Numerical Scheme for the Compressible Low-Mach Number Regime of Ideal Fluid Dynamics (2017) 書誌や章の参照先の案内です。原文・式の確認範囲は元の章とJSONのscope欄を参照してください。 この項目 / JSON · この項目 / Markdown · 引用と利用条件 Coupling, constraints & particles Low-Mach PDE preconditioning Educational example / related code Distinguish acoustic/convective scales and pseudo-time mass-matrix preconditioning from numerical-dissipation preconditioning. A dedicated lightweight example compares a Miczek-type Roe dissipation matrix with ordinary Roe while retaining physical time. Other names: low Mach preconditioning / 低マッハ数前処理 / 低Mach数前処理 / PDE preconditioning Read the formulation Read the chapter Assumptions for this example Smooth fixed isentropic-vortex data for the unforced 2D ideal-gas Euler equations; gamma=1.4. Matrix preconditioning is applied to numerical dissipation, retaining the physical-time mass matrix. Only the stated fixed Mach numbers, grids, acoustic CFL and short time interval are validated. Boundaries: Periodic finite box. The whole-plane Gaussian analytic vortex has tiny nonzero minimum-image seam tails, which are explicitly qualified. Units: Nondimensional: far-field density1, background velocity(1,.5), beta3, box[-10,10]^2; pressure scales consistently with the chosen background Mach number. Small dedicated implementations and measured checks A fixed smooth 2D Euler isentropic vortex at background Mach numbers .1 and .01 compares ordinary Roe and Miczek-type dissipation-matrix preconditioning D=P⁻¹|PA|, with unlimited central primitive-variable MUSCL reconstruction for both. SSPRK(3,3) retains physical time and the acoustic CFL. Velocity error, dynamically normalized pressure error, periodic conservation and sampled Fourier diagnostics are evaluated separately. Pseudo-time or dual-time steady acceleration, slope limiting and TVD guarantees remain outside this example. Steady acceleration, dual time stepping, shocks, general nonlinear stability/positivity, removal of the acoustic time-step restriction and uniform all-Mach accuracy remain outside validation.
